architecture.mechanism: Coupling fluid viscosity effect and multi-body interactions of solid contacting surfaces to analyze elastohydrodynamics.
architecture.intervention: Redesign the engine oil pan and valve cover gasket interface using a plastic composite material and optimize the sealing surface geometry based on coupled CFD and multi-body analysis to maintain positive contact pressure under thermal expansion, preventing oil egress onto the exhaust muffler.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of oil leakage by ensuring the gasket maintains a hydrodynamic seal despite thermal distortion of the pan and cover, thereby preventing oil contact with the hot exhaust muffler.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the redesigned plastic oil pan and gasket assembly to thermal cycling tests simulating exhaust manifold heat soak while monitoring for oil seepage at the gasket interface under varying engine vibration loads.
